title: BSA-ICG-Cu(II) complex as an NIR-responsive multifunctional platform for wound healing: deciphering therapeutic action in vitro
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16540-16554
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00155B, Paper
Open Access

Jayashree Roy, Sahely Saha, Manjari Shukla, Sudipta Bhattacharyya, Raviraj Vankayala, Indranil Banerjee
BSA-ICG-Cu(II) complex as an NIR responsive therapeutic agent exhibits bacteria-killing through photothermal and photodynamic properties, promotes angiogenesis, and supports fibroblast activity as required for chronic wound healing.
